execution.description: Ran the registry, campaign, construction-contract, admission-study and Motor focused suites before changing the Level-0 Launchpad integration.

expected: The focused baseline should identify pre-existing failures separately from the new Motor integration, with canonical Linux acceptance deferred to the repository wrapper and CI.
observed: The usable Windows environment ran 175 tests: 160 passed, 1 skipped and 14 failed. Thirteen failures were host/environment limitations involving POSIX resource, UID/GID and private-file behavior or missing optional MCP/cryptography packages. One failure was a pre-existing Motor decision construction-freeze mismatch on the current combined tree.
keep: Run the exact changed subsystem under canonical Linux before delivery.
Separate host diagnostic limitations and pre-existing failures from ticket regressions.
change: Use the dependency-complete carbon-ccm interpreter for local Windows diagnostics and treat repository CI as canonical when Docker is unavailable.
